name: get_invoice_status
description: FINANCE ONLY: get the payment status of a supplier invoice by invoice id (ids look like INV-1001). Returns the vendor, amount, currency, status (paid, pending or overdue) and due date. For the Finance team's accounts-payable assistant; not an HR tool.

invoice_id.description: Invoice id: INV- followed by four digits, for example INV-1001.
